name: Pochereth-hazzebaim
overview: Pochereth-hazzebaim is a male figure identified in Scripture as a servant of Solomon. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes, making his role as Solomon's servant the primary detail known about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Pochereth-hazzebaim means 'pitfall of gazelles,' which can be understood as 'gazelle hunter.' This proper name, recorded in Ezra 2:57, reflects a vivid Hebrew imagery but was not given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Pochereth-hazzebaim beyond his identification as Solomon's servant. No additional relational data is provided.
scriptureSignificance: Pochereth-hazzebaim's significance lies in his connection to Solomon, serving as one of his servants during the period recorded in Ezra. Although details about his life and actions are sparse, his mention underscores the broader community and personnel associated with Solomon's reign and the post-exilic restoration period.
